data.name: Axirun
data.gender_notes: Axirun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Axirun is derived from the Arabic word 'Akhir', which means 'last' or 'end'. Axirun means 'The First' as it is the opposite of the last. This name is often given to the firstborn child. The name Axirun carries the meaning “The First” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Axirun usually hope their child will grow to embody the first and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Axirun is a name that signifies the beginning of a new journey in life. It symbolizes hope, renewal, and the power to overcome challenges. The name carries a sense of positivity and optimism, encouraging the bearer to embrace the future with courage and determination.
data.etymology: Axirun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The First.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Axirun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أخيرون
in_arabic.meaning: الأخيرون هم الذين يأتون في النهاية أو الأخيرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أخيرون هو اسم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أ-خ-ر' والذي يدل على معنى التأخير أو النهاية. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الجذر في العديد من الكلمات التي تعبر عن الفكرة نفسها، مثل 'آخر' و'أخيرة'. الاسم 'أخيرون' يشير إلى الأشخاص الذين يأتون في النهاية أو الأخيرة، وقد يكون له دلالة على الأجيال الأخيرة أو الناس الذين يعيشون في آخر الزمان. في بعض الأحيان، يُستخدم هذا الاسم كدلالة على الأهمية أو الفضل الذي يأتي في النهاية.

in_urdu.name: اخیرون
in_urdu.meaning: وہ لوگ جو آخری یا سب سے آخر میں آتے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: اخیرون ایک نام ہے جو عربی جذر 'أ-خ-ر' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تاخیر یا انتہا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو آخری یا سب سے آخر میں آتے ہیں۔ یہ نام ان لوگوں کو مخاطب کرنے کے لیے استعمال کیا جا سکتا ہے جو آخری نسل یا آخری زمانے میں رہتے ہیں۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم کے آخر یا قیامت کے دن سے بھی منسلک ہو سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अख़ीरुन
in_hindi.meaning: जो लोग आखिर में आते हैं या अंतिम पीढ़ी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अख़ीरुन एक नाम है जो अरबी जड़ 'أ-خ-ر' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है देर या अंत। हिंदी में, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो आखिर में आते हैं या अंतिम पीढ़ी हैं। यह नाम उन लोगों को संबोधित करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जा सकता है जो आखिरी समय में रहते हैं या कयामत के दिन से जुड़े होते हैं। यह नाम हिंदुस्तानी मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: اخیرون
in_pashto.meaning: د هغو کسانو نوم چې په آخر کې راځي
in_pashto.long_meaning: اخیرون د یو نوم دی چې د عربي ريښې 'أ-خ-ر' څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د تاخیر يا انتهاء معنی ورکوي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې په آخر کې راځي يا وروستی نسل دي. دا نوم کولای شي د هغو کسانو لپاره استعمال شي چې په وروستیو زمانو کې ژوند کوي يا د قیامت د ورځې سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Axirun
in_english.meaning: those who come last or the last generation
in_english.long_meaning: Axirun is a name derived from the Arabic root 'أ-خ-ر' (A-KH-R), which conveys the meaning of delay or end. In Islamic context, this name refers to those who come last or the last generation, potentially linking to the end of times or the Day of Judgment. The name Axirun holds significance in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the final era or the last people on earth. Etymologically, it shares roots with words like 'akhir' (last) and 'akhirah' (the hereafter).

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic culture, the birth order plays an essential role in naming a child. The eldest child in a family is often given a name that denotes their position of leadership and responsibility. Axirun, as the name for the firstborn, signifies their importance as the beginning of a new generation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Axirun symbolizes a new beginning, renewal, and a fresh start being given to a family. It also signifies the idea that each new life is a unique and precious gift from Allah, deserving of love, guidance, and respect. The name serves as a reminder for the parents to instill the best values and virtues in their child, to help them grow into a righteous and pious person.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Axirun is derived from the Arabic word 'Axir', meaning the last, end, or culmination. It is often given to a child born last in a family, signifying their role as the final piece in completing the family unit. Symbolically, it represents the idea of reaching the pinnacle of one's journey in life, and fulfilling one's purpose before the end.
